newsitem.title: UK: NWE jet gains on futures, avails plentiful.
newsitem.headline: NWE jet gains on futures, avails plentiful.

text.p: NWE jet fuel rose on firmer futures for the second straight day on Tuesday but cargo differentials were under pressure from ample supply, traders said.
July IPE gas oil closed $2.50 higher at $167.75.
Barges were assessed unchanged at July IPE +$16 fob ARA. Cargo premiums cif NWE were talked around July IPE +$17.
In the Mediterranean, non-EU spec Libyan material was assessed at high fob quotes +$5/7. EU spec grades were around high fob quotes $6.50/8.50.
